title: Four continuations; three timing constraints.
summary: All seven late endpoints are audited. Four have verified checkpoint continuations; one must complete too early and two cannot reach required progress in time. Every queried state passes independent scalar replay.
boundary: Bounds apply to the declared numerical source model. None of the four witnesses completes the route. No integrated rerun: best retained 3/4, adverse candidate 2/4, source comparison closed. Actual-history intervention remains unestablished.
next: Test necessary-constraint eligibility before selection, preserving uncertain states, all budgets and explicit lost-success accounting against both the retained baseline and experimental parent.
